productArea.name: Releases and release tags
productArea.scope: Search and manage releases and tags, including drafts, publication, prereleases, creation, editing, deletion, tag and title validation, attachments, external assets, and source archives. Repository file editing and Actions are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Releases in the seeded repository, then create or open a release to edit its publication, tag, and assets.
Choose Tags to inspect release tags and their archive and release links.
Choose New Release from the release list.
